body.p: A partridge and a pike. Once a partridge and a pike met. It was summer. You won't see a partridge in summer. It is mottled, like the earth. In summer it becomes mottled, it is not visible. The partridge sits on the shore.[ShA:] Both pazur and kan'ema are not clear and unexpected here. Taking the arrows, she shoots from a bow into the water. The partridge's arrows fall down far away. They fall down deep into the water. It shot, shot and flew away. It left the bow. The partridge's arrows hit the pike. They hit the pike's back. The whole back of the pike is covered with arrows. Many arrows hit. The pike [ShA:] Normally, nominative maxa-za is expected here.got angry. It took the bow and started shooting up. Arrows appeared out of the water.
